output_dir.description: Directory where received text will be stored on disk.

port.description: TCP port the daemon listens on.

domain.description: Domain used to construct public URLs for uploaded pastes (required).

slug_size.description: Number of characters in the generated slug (minimum 3).

user.description: Unix user account under which files are written.

max_file_size.description: Maximum allowed uploaded file size in bytes.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for fiche events.

ban_file.description: Path to file containing one banned IP address per line.

whitelist_file.description: Path to file containing one allowed IP address per line when whitelist mode is enabled.

enable_whitelist.description: If true, only IPs in the whitelist file may upload pastes.
